You have three seasons of ball-by-ball history in `league/` and a list of\n6\tfixtures for the coming season with the announced line-ups. For every fixture, give the probability that the home side wins.\n7\t\n8\tYou deliver a program. It is run on this league and on other leagues of the same kind that you have not seen, so it has to learn\n9\teverything it needs from the league folder it is given.\n10\t\n11\t    python solution/forecast.py --league <folder> --out <file.csv>\n12\t\n13\tThe output file has two columns, `fixture` and `p_home`, with exactly one row per fixture in `<folder>/fixtures.csv`, no extra or duplicate fixture IDs, and finite probabilities in [0, 1]. Row order does not matter.\n14\t\n15\t## How a forecast is graded\n16\t\n17\tThe league is simulated, so the task author can estimate each fixture's home-win probability using the hidden state. The stored estimates use\n18\t100,000 simulations per batting order. They have Monte Carlo error, but are fixed before grading: no new match result is sampled to score your program.\n19\t\n20\tFor a fixture with true probability `p` and forecast `q`, the penalty is `p*ln(p/q) + (1-p)*ln((1-p)/(1-q))`. It is zero when `q = p` and\n21\tgrows quickly when a forecast is confident and wrong. Forecasts are clipped to [0.002, 0.998]. Your regret on a league is the\n22\taverage penalty over its fixtures.\n23\t\n24\tYour regret is compared with that of a reference forecaster. At runtime the reference reads the same public files and engine you have. Its design\n25\tuses prior scales informed by the generating spreads; it is therefore a designer-informed benchmark, not a claim of equal prior information.\n26\tIt simulates each fixture 4,000 times per batting order. Your program is run on this league and on seven leagues you have not seen. You pass\n27\tif your regret, summed over all eight leagues, is at most 10 percent above the reference's sum, and the same holds for the seven\n28\tunseen leagues on their own. On a single\n31\tleague anything can happen. Some leagues have little to predict, and there the reference itself can be close to the coin flip.\n32\t\n33\t## The files in a league folder\n34\t\n35\t| file | one row per | columns |\n36\t|---|---|---|\n37\t| `balls.csv` | legal ball | `season, match, innings, over, ball, batting_team, bowling_team, venue, batter, bowler, outcome, extra, position, wickets_before, runs_before, target` |\n38\t| `matches.csv` | match | `season, match, week, home, away, venue, toss_winner, batted_first, first_total, second_total, winner` |\n39\t| `lineups.csv` | player in a past match | `match, team, batting_slot, player, bowling_slot` |\n40\t| `players.csv` | player | `player, role, hand, bowling_style` |\n41\t| `venues.csv` | venue | `venue, home_team, pitch` |\n42\t| `fixtures.csv` | fixture to forecast | `fixture, season, home, away, venue` |\n43\t| `fixture_lineups.csv` | player in a fixture | `fixture, team, batting_slot, player, bowling_slot` |\n44\t\n45\t`outcome` is one of `W, 0, 1, 2, 4, 6`. `extra` is 1 when the ball also produced one extra run. `position` is the batter's place in the\n46\torder, from 0. `target` is 0 in the first innings. `bowling_slot` is -1 for players who do not bowl. `engine/league_io.py` reads a folder\n47\tinto the objects the engine uses.\n48\t\n49\t## How a ball works (all of this is public)\n50\t\n51\t`engine/model.py` is the engine, and `engine/public.json` holds its public constants. They are the exact definition; this section\n52\tdescribes them in words.\n53\t\n54\tEvery legal ball has six possible outcomes. Their probabilities come from a sum of effects on the log scale:\n55\t\n56\t1. a profile for the over being bowled (`over_logits`), a shift for the batter's position (`position_vectors`);\n57\t2. the match situation: how many more wickets have fallen than is usual at that over (`wickets_vector`), and in the second innings a\n58\t   constant shift plus the chase pressure, which is the log of the required run rate over the usual rate from that over on, clipped to\n59\t   [-1, 1.2] (`second_innings_vector`, `pressure_vector`, `par_rate`);\n60\t3. the batter's **style** and **quality**, the bowler's **type** and **quality**, and the **conditions**, each a single number that moves\n61\t   the six outcomes along a fixed public direction (`directions`).\n62\t\n63\tOn top of the ball, with a fixed probability one extra run is added (`extras_per_ball`). Batters bat in line-up order. The strike changes\n64\ton an odd number of runs and at the end of each over. The five bowlers bowl in rotation, one over each in turn. An innings ends after 120\n65\tlegal balls, ten wickets, or when the target is reached. The toss is a coin flip and the winner always chases. A tied match is settled by\n66\ta coin flip.\n67\t\n68\t## What is hidden, and how it is built\n69\t\n70\t* **Batters.** Style does not change. Quality is a fixed talent plus a form component that drifts slowly over months and is pulled back\n71\t  toward zero. A batter's quality can differ a little against pace and against spin. Every player bats, so every player has these values.\n72\t* **Bowlers.** Type is related to the public bowling style and does not change. Quality is talent plus slowly drifting form.\n73\t* **Conditions.** A level for each venue; a league-wide level that moves from season to season and keeps moving; a pitch-on-the-day\n74\t  effect drawn afresh for every match and shared by both innings; dew at some venues, which helps the chase; a small general\n75\t  disadvantage for the side batting second; a lift for batters at their home ground; a personal liking of each batter for each venue;\n76\t  small league-wide effects of batting hand against bowling style and of pitch type on bowling style.\n77\t* There is **no** effect that belongs to one specific batter against one specific bowler.\n78\t* Between seasons about a quarter of the players change teams, and line-ups rotate heavily from match to match.\n79\t\n80\tThe fixtures are played at the start of the next season. Skills are as they stand at that moment, after one more off-season of drift.\n81\t\n82\t## Rules for your program\n83\t\n84\t* Everything it needs must be under `solution/` as ordinary files and directories, with no symbolic links or special files. Fix your random seeds.\n87\t* It has 12 minutes per league on two CPU cores and must not use the network.\n88\t* The engine is yours to use in any way you like, including to test your own method on leagues you simulate yourself.\n89\t\n90\t## Source\n91\t\n92\tCalibration constants derived from data sourced from Cricsheet (cricsheet.org), licensed under the Open Data Commons Attribution License\n93\t(ODC-BY 1.0). You have three seasons of ball-by-ball history in `league/` and a list of\nfixtures for the coming season with the announced line-ups. For every fixture, give the probability that the home side wins.\n\nYou deliver a program. It is run on this league and on other leagues of the same kind that you have not seen, so it has to learn\neverything it needs from the league folder it is given.\n\n    python solution/forecast.py --league <folder> --out <file.csv>\n\nThe output file has two columns, `fixture` and `p_home`, with exactly one row per fixture in `<folder>/fixtures.csv`, no extra or duplicate fixture IDs, and finite probabilities in [0, 1]. Row order does not matter.\n\n## How a forecast is graded\n\nThe league is simulated, so the task author can estimate each fixture's home-win probability using the hidden state. The stored estimates use\n100,000 simulations per batting order. They have Monte Carlo error, but are fixed before grading: no new match result is sampled to score your program.\n\nFor a fixture with true probability `p` and forecast `q`, the penalty is `p*ln(p/q) + (1-p)*ln((1-p)/(1-q))`. It is zero when `q = p` and\ngrows quickly when a forecast is confident and wrong. Forecasts are clipped to [0.002, 0.998]. Your regret on a league is the\naverage penalty over its fixtures.\n\nYour regret is compared with that of a reference forecaster. At runtime the reference reads the same public files and engine you have. Its design\nuses prior scales informed by the generating spreads; it is therefore a designer-informed benchmark, not a claim of equal prior information.\nIt simulates each fixture 4,000 times per batting order. Your program is run on this league and on seven leagues you have not seen. You pass\nif your regret, summed over all eight leagues, is at most 10 percent above the reference's sum, and the same holds for the seven\nunseen leagues on their own. Simulation noise in your own forecasts counts against you, so play each fixture enough times.\n\nFor orientation, summed over leagues like these a coin flip (0.5 everywhere) has a little under twice the reference's regret. On a single\nleague anything can happen. Some leagues have little to predict, and there the reference itself can be close to the coin flip.\n\n## The files in a league folder\n\n| file | one row per | columns |\n|---|---|---|\n| `balls.csv` | legal ball | `season, match, innings, over, ball, batting_team, bowling_team, venue, batter, bowler, outcome, extra, position, wickets_before, runs_before, target` |\n| `matches.csv` | match | `season, match, week, home, away, venue, toss_winner, batted_first, first_total, second_total, winner` |\n| `lineups.csv` | player in a past match | `match, team, batting_slot, player, bowling_slot` |\n| `players.csv` | player | `player, role, hand, bowling_style` |\n| `venues.csv` | venue | `venue, home_team, pitch` |\n| `fixtures.csv` | fixture to forecast | `fixture, season, home, away, venue` |\n| `fixture_lineups.csv` | player in a fixture | `fixture, team, batting_slot, player, bowling_slot` |\n\n`outcome` is one of `W, 0, 1, 2, 4, 6`. `extra` is 1 when the ball also produced one extra run. `position` is the batter's place in the\norder, from 0. `target` is 0 in the first innings. `bowling_slot` is -1 for players who do not bowl. `engine/league_io.py` reads a folder\ninto the objects the engine uses.\n\n## How a ball works (all of this is public)\n\n`engine/model.py` is the engine, and `engine/public.json` holds its public constants. They are the exact definition; this section\ndescribes them in words.\n\nEvery legal ball has six possible outcomes. Their probabilities come from a sum of effects on the log scale:\n\n1. a profile for the over being bowled (`over_logits`), a shift for the batter's position (`position_vectors`);\n2. the match situation: how many more wickets have fallen than is usual at that over (`wickets_vector`), and in the second innings a\n   constant shift plus the chase pressure, which is the log of the required run rate over the usual rate from that over on, clipped to\n   [-1, 1.2] (`second_innings_vector`, `pressure_vector`, `par_rate`);\n3. the batter's **style** and **quality**, the bowler's **type** and **quality**, and the **conditions**, each a single number that moves\n   the six outcomes along a fixed public direction (`directions`).\n\nOn top of the ball, with a fixed probability one extra run is added (`extras_per_ball`). Batters bat in line-up order. The strike changes\non an odd number of runs and at the end of each over. The five bowlers bowl in rotation, one over each in turn. An innings ends after 120\nlegal balls, ten wickets, or when the target is reached. The toss is a coin flip and the winner always chases. A tied match is settled by\na coin flip.\n\n## What is hidden, and how it is built\n\n* **Batters.** Style does not change. Quality is a fixed talent plus a form component that drifts slowly over months and is pulled back\n  toward zero. A batter's quality can differ a little against pace and against spin. Every player bats, so every player has these values.\n* **Bowlers.** Type is related to the public bowling style and does not change. Quality is talent plus slowly drifting form.\n* **Conditions.** A level for each venue; a league-wide level that moves from season to season and keeps moving; a pitch-on-the-day\n  effect drawn afresh for every match and shared by both innings; dew at some venues, which helps the chase; a small general\n  disadvantage for the side batting second; a lift for batters at their home ground; a personal liking of each batter for each venue;\n  small league-wide effects of batting hand against bowling style and of pitch type on bowling style.\n* There is **no** effect that belongs to one specific batter against one specific bowler.\n* Between seasons about a quarter of the players change teams, and line-ups rotate heavily from match to match.\n\nThe fixtures are played at the start of the next season. Skills are as they stand at that moment, after one more off-season of drift.\n\n## Rules for your program\n\n* Everything it needs must be under `solution/` as ordinary files and directories, with no symbolic links or special files. The entry point is `solution/forecast.py`. It may import `engine`, which the grader\n  supplies unchanged, and `numpy`, `pandas`, `scipy` and the Python standard library. Do not change anything under `engine/`.\n* It must give the same output every time it is run on the same folder. Fix your random seeds.\n* It has 12 minutes per league on two CPU cores and must not use the network.\n* The engine is yours to use in any way you like, including to test your own method on leagues you simulate yourself.\n\n## Source\n\nCalibration constants derived from data sourced from Cricsheet (cricsheet.org), licensed under the Open Data Commons Attribution License\n(ODC-BY 1.0). {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01G9wc8235EmQcomCdHmNWRU","type":"tool_result","content":"1\timport json\n2\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\n3\tfrom pathlib import Path\n4\timport numpy as np\n5\timport pandas as pd\n6\t\n7\t# runs scored by each of the six outcomes, in the order W, 0, 1, 2, 4, 6; a wicket scores nothing\n8\tRUNS = np.array([0, 0, 1, 2, 4, 6])\n9\t# the two bowling styles, as integers so they can index tables\n10\tPACE, SPIN = 0, 1\n11\t\n12\t@dataclass\n13\tclass PlayerTable:\n14\t    # one entry per player in the league, indexed by player id; these are public facts about a player\n15\t    role: np.ndarray\n16\t    hand: np.ndarray # 0 right, 1 left\n17\t    style: np.ndarray # PACE or SPIN; meaningful only for players who bowl\n18\t\n19\t@dataclass\n20\tclass VenueTable:\n21\t    # one entry per ground, indexed by venue id; also public\n22\t    home_team: np.ndarray\n23\t    pitch: np.ndarray # 0 neutral, 1 helps pace, 2 helps spin\n24\t\n25\t@dataclass\n26\tclass Fixture:\n27\t    # one match's line-ups: the eleven and the five bowlers for each side, plus where and when it is played\n28\t    match: int\n29\t    season: int\n30\t    home: int\n31\t    away: int\n32\t    venue: int\n33\t    home_xi: np.ndarray\n34\t    home_bowlers: np.ndarray\n35\t    away_xi: np.ndarray\n36\t    away_bowlers: np.ndarray\n37\t\n38\t@dataclass\n39\tclass History:\n40\t    # everything an AI agent is allowed to see about the past: every ball, every match, the players, the grounds, the line-ups\n41\t    balls: pd.DataFrame\n42\t    matches: pd.DataFrame\n43\t    players: PlayerTable\n44\t    venues: VenueTable\n45\t    played: list = field(default_factory = list) # the Fixture of every past match (who played, who bowled)\n46\t    seasons: int = 0\n47\t\n48\t@dataclass\n49\tclass BattingCard:\n50\t    # what the innings simulator needs about the eleven batters of one side in one match; built by SkillBook.cards\n51\t    style: np.ndarray        \n52\t    quality: np.ndarray      \n53\t    conditions: np.ndarray   # (11, 5): venue affinity, home lift, hand-by-style and pitch effects for each batter-bowler meeting\n54\t\n55\t@dataclass\n56\tclass BowlingCard:\n57\t    # the same for the five bowlers of the other side\n58\t    kind: np.ndarray\n59\t    quality: np.ndarray\n60\t\n61\tclass BallModel:\n62\t    # Public part of a ball. Holds the measured constants and the five directions; adds up the situation. Nothing hidden lives here.\n63\t    def __init__(self, cal):\n64\t        self.cal = cal\n65\t        d = cal.directions\n66\t        # short names for the five unit vectors: batter style, batter quality, bowler type, bowler quality, conditions\n67\t        self.bs = d[\"bat_style\"]\n68\t        self.bq = d[\"bat_quality\"]\n69\t        self.wt = d[\"bowl_type\"]\n70\t        self.wq = d[\"bowl_quality\"]\n71\t        self.c = d[\"conditions\"]\n72\t\n73\t    def pressure(self, target, runs, ball):\n74\t        # chase pressure, the same formula as in the fit: log of the rate still needed over the rate sides usually maange from here.\n75\t        # `ball` counts legal balls from 0 to 119, so (120 - ball) / 6 is the overs left. Clipped so freak situations do not dominate.\n76\t        need = np.clip(target - runs, 1, None) / ((120 - ball) / 6)\n77\t        return np.clip(np.log(need / self.cal.par_rate[ball // 6]), -1.0, 1.2)\n78\t\n79\t    def situation(self, over, position, wickets, chasing, pressure):\n80\t        \"\"\"\n81\t        The public part of the logits: the over, the batting position and the match situation. PACE,\n    SkillBook,\n    load_public_model,\n)\n\n\ndef _public_logits(model, over, position, wickets_before, chasing, pressure):\n    cal = model.cal\n    z = cal.over_logits[over] + = z + np.multiply.outer(pressure, cal.pressure_vector)\n    return z\n\n\ndef fit_hidden(history, model, n_iter=40, verbose=False):\n    balls = history.balls\n    players = history.players\n    venues = history.venues\n    cal = model.cal\n    N = len(balls)\n\n    outcome = balls.outcome.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    over = balls.over.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    position = balls.position.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    wickets_before = balls.wickets_before.to_numpy().astype(float)\n    runs_before = balls.runs_before.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    target_arr = cal.par_rate[over]\n    press = np.clip(np.log(need_rate / par), -1.0, 1.2)\n    pressure = np.where(chasing > 0, press, 0.0)\n\n    z_pub = _public_logits(model, over, position, wickets_before, chasing, pressure)\n\n    batter = balls.batter.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    bowler = balls.bowler.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    venue = balls.venue.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n home_of_venue).astype(float)\n\n    sign_ps = np.where(bowl_style_ball == PACE, 0.5, -0.5)\n\n    n_players = len(players.role)\n    n_venues = len(venues.pitch)\n    n_seasons = int(history.seasons)\n\n    matches_unique = np.unique(match_id)\n    m2i = {int(m): i for i, m in enumerate(matches_unique)}\n    match_idx = np.array([m2i[int(m)] for m in match_id])\n    n_matches = len(matches_unique)\n\n    bowled = np.zeros(n_players, dtype=bool)\n    bowled[np.unique(bowler)] = True\n\n    style = np.zeros(n_players)\n    quality = np.zeros(n_players)\n    split = np.zeros(n_players)\n    kind = np.zeros(n_players)\n    bowl_quality = np.zeros(n_players)\n    venue_level = np.zeros(n_venues)\n    venue_dew = np.zeros(n_venues)\n    affinity = np.zeros((n_players, n_venues))\n    era = np.zeros(n_seasons)\n    home_lift = 0.0\n    wear = 0.0\n    type_table = np.zeros((2, 2))\n    pitch_table = np.zeros((2, 3))\n    day = np.zeros(n_matches)\n\n    bs = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bat_style\"])\n    bq = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bat_quality\"])\n    wt = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bowl_type\"])\n    wq = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bowl_quality\"])\n    cc = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"conditions\"])\n    bs2, bq2, wt2, wq2, cc2 = bs**2, bq**2, wt**2, wq**2, cc**2\n\n    # Prior variances (informed guesses).\n    var_style = 0.6**2\n    var_quality = 0.8**2\n    var_split = 0.3**2\n    var_kind = 1.0**2\n    var_bwlq = 0.8**2\n    var_vlevel = 0.3**2\n    var_vdew = 0.25**2\n    var_aff = 0.15**2\n    var_era = 0.3**2\n    var_home = 0.25**2\n    var_wear = 0.2**2\n    var_typet = 0.15**2\n    var_pitcht = 0.25**2\n    var_day = 0.25**2\n\n    hand_style_ix = hand * 2 + bowl_style_ball\n    style_pitch_ix = bowl_style_ball * 3 + pitch\n    bv_idx = batter * n_venues + venue\n    sign2 = sign_ps * sign_ps  # constantly 0.25\n\n    idxN = np.arange(N)\n\n    for it in         venue_level[venue]\n            + era[season]\n            + affinity[batter, venue]\n            + at_home * home_lift\n            + type_table[hand, bowl_style_ball]\n            - - (p @ bq) ** 2\n        pd_wt = p @ wt2 - (p @ wt) ** 2\n        pd_wq = p @ wq2 - (p @ wq) ** 2\n        pd_c = p @ cc2 - (p @ cc) ** 2\n\n        # Batter parameters\n        num = np.bincount(batter, weights=g_bs, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(batter, weights=pd_bs, minlength=n_players)\n        style = style + (num - style / var_style) / (den + 1.0 / var_style)\n\n        num = np.bincount(batter, weights=g_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(batter, weights=pd_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        quality = quality + (num - quality / var_quality) / (den + 1.0 / var_quality)\n\n        num = np.bincount(batter, weights=sign_ps * g_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(batter, weights=sign2 * pd_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        split = split + (num - split / var_split) / (den + 1.0 / var_split)\n\n        # Bowler parameters\n        num = np.bincount(bowler, weights=g_wt, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(bowler, weights=pd_wt, minlength=n_players)\n        kind = kind + (num - kind / var_kind) / (den + 1.0 / var_kind)\n        kind[~bowled] = 0.0\n\n        num = np.bincount(bowler, weights=g_wq, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(bowler, weights=pd_wq, minlength=n_players)\n        bowl_quality = bowl_quality + (num - bowl_quality / var_bwlq) / (den + 1.0 / var_bwlq)\n        bowl_quality[~bowled] = 0.0\n\n        # Venue level\n        num = np.bincount(venue, weights=g_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        den = np.bincount(venue, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        venue_level = venue_level + (num - venue_level / var_vlevel) / (den + 1.0 / var_vlevel)\n\n        # Venue dew (only when chasing)\n        num = np.bincount(venue, weights=chasing * g_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        den = np.bincount(venue, weights=chasing * pd_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        venue_dew = venue_dew + (num - venue_dew / var_vdew) / (den + 1.0 / var_vdew)\n\n        # Era per season\n        num = np.bincount(season, weights=g_c, minlength=n_seasons)\n        den = np.bincount(season, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_seasons)\n        era = era + (num - era / var_era) / (den + 1.0 / var_era)\n\n        # Home lift (scalar; coefficient = at_home)\n        g_home = float(np.sum(at_home * g_c))\n        h_home = float(np.sum(at_home * pd_c))\n        home_lift = home_lift + (g_home - home_lift / var_home) / (h_home + 1.0 / var_home)\n\n        # Wear (scalar; coefficient = -chasing)\n        g_wear = float(np.sum(-chasing * g_c))\n        h_wear = float(np.sum(chasing * pd_c))\n        wear = wear + (g_wear - wear / var_wear) / (h_wear + 1.0 / var_wear)\n\n        # Type table [hand, bowl_style]\n        num = np.bincount(hand_style_ix, weights=g_c, minlength=4).reshape(2, 2)\n        den = np.bincount(hand_style_ix, weights=pd_c, minlength=4).reshape(2, 2)\n        type_table = type_table + (num - type_table / var_typet) / (den + 1.0 / var_typet)\n\n        # Pitch table [bowl_style, pitch] with negative sign coefficient\n        num = np.bincount(style_pitch_ix, weights=-g_c, minlength=6).reshape(2, 3)\n        den = np.bincount(style_pitch_ix, weights=pd_c, minlength=6).reshape(2, 3)\n        pitch_table = pitch_table + (num - pitch_table / var_pitcht) / (den + 1.0 / var_pitcht)\n\n        # Affinity per (batter, venue)\n        num = np.bincount(bv_idx, weights=g_c, minlength=n_players * n_venues).reshape(n_players, n_venues)\n        den = np.bincount(bv_idx, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_players * n_venues).reshape(n_players, n_venues)\n        affinity = affinity + (num - affinity / var_aff) / (den + 1.0 / var_aff)\n\n        # Day-of-match effect (per match)\n        num = np.bincount(match_idx, weights=g_c, minlength=n_matches)\n        den = np.bincount(match_idx, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_matches)\n        day = day + (num - day / var_day) / (den + 1.0 / var_day)\n\n        if verbose:\n            # log-likelihood on the same P we just computed\n            ll = float(np.log(np.maximum(p[idxN, outcome], 1e-30)).sum())\n            print(f\"iter {it}: ll = {ll:.2f}\")\n\n    # Estimate day_sd from spread of fitted per-match day effects.\n    # Fitted day is shrunk toward 0 by the prior; empirical std is a reasonable\n    # rough estimate (the pitch spread is what the simulator draws from).\n    if n_matches > 1:\n        day_sd = float(np.std(day))\n    else:\n        day_sd = 0.0\n\n    # Extrapolate era to the next season by linear fit on observed seasons.\n    if n_seasons >= 2:\n        s = np.arange(n_seasons)\n        a, b = np.polyfit(s, era, 1)\n        era_future = float(a * n_seasons + b)\n    else:\n pressure only in chase\n    overs_remaining = np.maximum((120 - ball_total) / 6.0, 1e-6)\n    need_rate = np.maximum(target_arr - runs_before, 1).astype(float) / overs_remaining\n    par = cal.par_rate[over]\n    press = np.clip(np.log(need_rate / par), -1.0, 1.2)\n    pressure = np.where(chasing > 0, press, 0.0)\n\n    z_pub = _public_logits(model, over, position, wickets_before, chasing, pressure)\n\n    batter = balls.batter.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    bowler = balls.bowler.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    venue = balls.venue.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    batting_team = balls.batting_team.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    match_id = balls.match.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    season = balls.season.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n\n    hand = players.hand[batter]\n    bowl_style_ball = players.style[bowler]\n    pitch = venues.pitch[venue]\n    home_of_venue = venues.home_team[venue]\n    at_home = (batting_team == home_of_venue).astype(float)\n\n    sign_ps = np.where(bowl_style_ball == PACE, 0.5, -0.5)\n\n    n_players = len(players.role)\n    n_venues = len(venues.pitch)\n    n_seasons = int(history.seasons)\n\n    matches_unique = np.unique(match_id)\n    m2i = {int(m): i for i, m in enumerate(matches_unique)}\n    match_idx = np.array([m2i[int(m)] for m in match_id])\n    n_matches = len(matches_unique)\n\n    bowled = np.zeros(n_players, dtype=bool)\n    bowled[np.unique(bowler)] = True\n\n    style = np.zeros(n_players)\n    quality = np.zeros(n_players)\n    split = np.zeros(n_players)\n    kind = np.zeros(n_players)\n    bowl_quality = np.zeros(n_players)\n    venue_level = np.zeros(n_venues)\n    venue_dew = np.zeros(n_venues)\n    affinity = np.zeros((n_players, n_venues))\n    era = np.zeros(n_seasons)\n    home_lift = 0.0\n    wear = 0.0\n    type_table = np.zeros((2, 2))\n    pitch_table = np.zeros((2, 3))\n    day = np.zeros(n_matches)\n\n    bs = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bat_style\"])\n    bq = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bat_quality\"])\n    wt = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bowl_type\"])\n    wq = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bowl_quality\"])\n    cc = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"conditions\"])\n    bs2, bq2, wt2, wq2, cc2 = bs**2, bq**2, wt**2, wq**2, cc**2\n\n    # Prior variances (informed guesses).\n    var_style = 0.6**2\n    var_quality = 0.8**2\n    var_split = 0.3**2\n    var_kind = 1.0**2\n    var_bwlq = 0.8**2\n    var_vlevel = 0.3**2\n    var_vdew = 0.25**2\n    var_aff = 0.15**2\n    var_era = 0.3**2\n    var_home = 0.25**2\n    var_wear = 0.2**2\n    var_typet = 0.15**2\n    var_pitcht = 0.25**2\n    var_day = 0.25**2\n\n    hand_style_ix = hand * 2 + bowl_style_ball\n    style_pitch_ix = bowl_style_ball * 3 + pitch\n    bv_idx = batter * n_venues + venue\n    sign2 = sign_ps * sign_ps  # constantly 0.25\n\n    idxN = np.arange(N)\n\n    for it in range(n_iter):\n        h_style = style[batter]\n        h_bq = quality[batter] + split[batter] * sign_ps\n        h_kind = kind[bowler]\n        h_bwlq = bowl_quality[bowler]\n        h_cond = (\n            venue_level[venue]\n            + era[season]\n            + affinity[batter, venue]\n            + at_home * home_lift\n            + type_table[hand, bowl_style_ball]\n            - pitch_table[bowl_style_ball, pitch]\n            + chasing * (venue_dew[venue] - wear)\n            + day[match_idx]\n        )\n        z = (\n            z_pub\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_style, bs)\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_bq, bq)\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_kind, wt)\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_bwlq, wq)\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_cond, cc)\n        )\n        z = z - z.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n        p = np.exp(z)\n        p = p / p.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n\n        r = -p.copy()\n        r[idxN, outcome] += 1.0\n\n        g_bs = r @ bs\n        g_bq = r @ bq\n        g_wt = r @ wt\n        g_wq = r @ wq\n        g_c = r @ cc\n\n        pd_bs = p @ bs2 - (p @ bs) ** 2\n        pd_bq = p @ bq2 - (p @ bq) ** 2\n        pd_wt = p @ wt2 - (p @ wt) ** 2\n        pd_wq = p @ wq2 - (p @ wq) ** 2\n        pd_c = p @ cc2 - (p @ cc) ** 2\n\n        # Batter parameters\n        num = np.bincount(batter, weights=g_bs, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(batter, weights=pd_bs, minlength=n_players)\n        style = style + (num - style / var_style) / (den + 1.0 / var_style)\n\n        num = np.bincount(batter, weights=g_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(batter, weights=pd_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        quality = quality + (num - quality / var_quality) / (den + 1.0 / var_quality)\n\n        num = np.bincount(batter, weights=sign_ps * g_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(batter, weights=sign2 * pd_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        split = split + (num - split / var_split) / (den + 1.0 / var_split)\n\n        # Bowler parameters\n        num = np.bincount(bowler, weights=g_wt, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(bowler, weights=pd_wt, minlength=n_players)\n        kind = kind + (num - kind / var_kind) / (den + 1.0 / var_kind)\n        kind[~bowled] = 0.0\n\n        num = np.bincount(bowler, weights=g_wq, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(bowler, weights=pd_wq, minlength=n_players)\n        bowl_quality = bowl_quality + (num - bowl_quality / var_bwlq) / (den + 1.0 / var_bwlq)\n        bowl_quality[~bowled] = 0.0\n\n        # Venue level\n        num = np.bincount(venue, weights=g_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        den = np.bincount(venue, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        venue_level = venue_level + (num - venue_level / var_vlevel) / (den + 1.0 / var_vlevel)\n\n        # Venue dew (only when chasing)\n        num = np.bincount(venue, weights=chasing * g_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        den = np.bincount(venue, weights=chasing * pd_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        venue_dew = venue_dew + (num - venue_dew / var_vdew) / (den + 1.0 / var_vdew)\n\n        # Era per season\n        num = np.bincount(season, weights=g_c, minlength=n_seasons)\n        den = np.bincount(season, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_seasons)\n        era = era + (num - era / var_era) / (den + 1.0 / var_era)\n\n        # Home lift (scalar; coefficient = at_home)\n        g_home = float(np.sum(at_home * g_c))\n        h_home = float(np.sum(at_home * pd_c))\n        home_lift = home_lift + (g_home - home_lift / var_home) / (h_home + 1.0 / var_home)\n\n        # Wear (scalar; coefficient = -chasing)\n        g_wear = float(np.sum(-chasing * g_c))\n        h_wear = float(np.sum(chasing * pd_c))\n        wear = wear + (g_wear - wear / var_wear) / (h_wear + 1.0 / var_wear)\n\n        # Type table [hand, bowl_style]\n        num = np.bincount(hand_style_ix, weights=g_c, minlength=4).reshape(2, 2)\n        den = np.bincount(hand_style_ix, weights=pd_c, minlength=4).reshape(2, 2)\n        type_table = type_table + (num - type_table / var_typet) / (den + 1.0 / var_typet)\n\n        # Pitch table [bowl_style, pitch] with negative sign coefficient\n        num = np.bincount(style_pitch_ix, weights=-g_c, minlength=6).reshape(2, 3)\n        den = np.bincount(style_pitch_ix, weights=pd_c, minlength=6).reshape(2, 3)\n        pitch_table = pitch_table + (num - pitch_table / var_pitcht) / (den + 1.0 / var_pitcht)\n\n        # Affinity per (batter, venue)\n        num = np.bincount(bv_idx, weights=g_c, minlength=n_players * n_venues).reshape(n_players, n_venues)\n        den = np.bincount(bv_idx, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_players * n_venues).reshape(n_players, n_venues)\n        affinity = affinity + (num - affinity / var_aff) / (den + 1.0 / var_aff)\n\n        # Day-of-match effect (per match)\n        num = np.bincount(match_idx, weights=g_c, minlength=n_matches)\n        den = np.bincount(match_idx, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_matches)\n        day = day + (num - day / var_day) / (den + 1.0 / var_day)\n\n        if verbose:\n            # log-likelihood on the same P we just computed\n            ll = float(np.log(np.maximum(p[idxN, outcome], 1e-30)).sum())\n            print(f\"iter {it}: ll = {ll:.2f}\")\n\n    # Estimate day_sd from spread of fitted per-match day effects.\n    # Fitted day is shrunk toward 0 by the prior; empirical std is a reasonable\n    # rough estimate (the pitch spread is what the simulator draws from).\n    if n_matches > 1:\n        day_sd = float(np.std(day))\n    else:\n        day_sd = 0.0\n\n    # Extrapolate era to the next season by linear fit on observed seasons.\n    if n_seasons >= 2:\n        s = np.arange(n_seasons)\n        a, b = np.polyfit(s, era, 1)\n        era_future = float(a * n_seasons + b)\n    else:\n        era_future = float(era[-1])\n\n    book = SkillBook(\n        players,\n        venues,\n        style,\n        quality,\n        split,\n        kind,\n        bowl_quality,\n        type_table,\n        pitch_table,\n        venue_level,\n        venue_dew,\n        affinity,\n        home_lift,\n        era_future,\n        day_sd,\n        wear,\n    )\n    return book\n\n\ndef main():\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--league\", required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--out\", required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--sims\", type=int, default=8000)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--iters\", type=int, default=40)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--seed\", type=int, default=0xC0FFEE)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--verbose\", action=\"store_true\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    np.random.seed(args.seed)\n    history, fixtures = load_league(args.league)\n    model = load_public_model()\n    book = fit_hidden(history, model, n_iter=args.iters, verbose=args.verbose)\n\n    simulator = MatchSimulator(model)\n    gen = np.random.default_rng(args.seed)\n    rows = []\n    for f in fixtures:\n        p = simulator.win_probability(book, f, args.sims, gen)\n        p = float(np.clip(p, 0.002, 0.998))\n        rows.append((f.match, p))\n    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=[\"fixture\", \"p_home\"])\n range(n_iter):\n        step = 0.35  # damping to keep the block-coordinate updates stable","originalFile":"\"\"\"Forecast home-win probabilities for the fixtures of a simulated T20 league.\n\nWe do MAP inference on the hidden per-player and per-venue values that enter\nthe engine's ball-by-ball logistic model, then Monte-Carlo simulate each\nfixture with the fitted SkillBook.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport argparse\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\n\n_HERE = Path(__file__).resolve()\nsys.path.insert(0, str(_HERE.parent.parent))\n\nfrom engine.league_io import load_league  # noqa: E402\nfrom engine.model import (  # noqa: E402\n    MatchSimulator,\n    PACE,\n    SkillBook,\n    load_public_model,\n)\n\n\ndef _public_logits(model, over, position, wickets_before, chasing, pressure):\n    cal = model.cal\n    z = cal.over_logits[over] + cal.position_vectors[position]\n    z = z + np.multiply.outer(wickets_before - cal.typical_wickets[over], cal.wickets_vector)\n    z = z + np.multiply.outer(chasing, cal.second_innings_vector)\n    z = z + np.multiply.outer(pressure, cal.pressure_vector)\n    return z\n\n\ndef fit_hidden(history, model, n_iter=40, verbose=False):\n    balls = history.balls\n    players = history.players\n    venues = history.venues\n    cal = model.cal\n    N = len(balls)\n\n    outcome = balls.outcome.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    over = balls.over.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    position = balls.position.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    wickets_before = balls.wickets_before.to_numpy().astype(float)\n    runs_before = balls.runs_before.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    target_arr = balls.target.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    chasing = (target_arr > 0).astype(float)\n    ball_in_over = balls.ball.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    ball_total = over * 6 + ball_in_over\n\n    # pressure only in chase\n    overs_remaining = np.maximum((120 - ball_total) / 6.0, 1e-6)\n    need_rate = np.maximum(target_arr - runs_before, 1).astype(float) / overs_remaining\n    par = cal.par_rate[over]\n    press = np.clip(np.log(need_rate / par), -1.0, 1.2)\n    pressure = np.where(chasing > 0, press, 0.0)\n\n    z_pub = _public_logits(model, over, position, wickets_before, chasing, pressure)\n\n    batter = balls.batter.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    bowler = balls.bowler.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    venue = balls.venue.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    batting_team = balls.batting_team.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    match_id = balls.match.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    season = balls.season.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n\n    hand = players.hand[batter]\n    bowl_style_ball = players.style[bowler]\n    pitch = venues.pitch[venue]\n    home_of_venue = venues.home_team[venue]\n    at_home = (batting_team == home_of_venue).astype(float)\n\n    sign_ps = np.where(bowl_style_ball == PACE, 0.5, -0.5)\n\n    n_players = len(players.role)\n    n_venues = len(venues.pitch)\n    n_seasons = int(history.seasons)\n\n    matches_unique = np.unique(match_id)\n    m2i = {int(m): i for i, m in enumerate(matches_unique)}\n    match_idx = np.array([m2i[int(m)] for m in match_id])\n    n_matches = len(matches_unique)\n\n    bowled = np.zeros(n_players, dtype=bool)\n    bowled[np.unique(bowler)] = True\n\n    style = np.zeros(n_players)\n    quality = np.zeros(n_players)\n    split = np.zeros(n_players)\n    kind = np.zeros(n_players)\n    bowl_quality = np.zeros(n_players)\n    venue_level = np.zeros(n_venues)\n    venue_dew = np.zeros(n_venues)\n    affinity = np.zeros((n_players, n_venues))\n    era = np.zeros(n_seasons)\n    home_lift = 0.0\n    wear = 0.0\n    type_table = np.zeros((2, 2))\n    pitch_table = np.zeros((2, 3))\n    day = np.zeros(n_matches)\n\n    bs = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bat_style\"])\n    bq = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bat_quality\"])\n    wt = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bowl_type\"])\n    wq = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bowl_quality\"])\n    cc = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"conditions\"])\n    bs2, bq2, wt2, wq2, cc2 = bs**2, bq**2, wt**2, wq**2, cc**2\n\n    # Prior variances (informed guesses).\n    var_style = 0.6**2\n    var_quality = 0.8**2\n    var_split = 0.3**2\n    var_kind = 1.0**2\n    var_bwlq = 0.8**2\n    var_vlevel = 0.3**2\n    var_vdew = 0.25**2\n    var_aff = 0.15**2\n    var_era = 0.3**2\n    var_home = 0.25**2\n    var_wear = 0.2**2\n    var_typet = 0.15**2\n    var_pitcht = 0.25**2\n    var_day = 0.25**2\n\n    hand_style_ix = hand * 2 + bowl_style_ball\n    style_pitch_ix = bowl_style_ball * 3 + pitch\n    bv_idx = batter * n_venues + venue\n    sign2 = sign_ps * sign_ps  # constantly 0.25\n\n    idxN = np.arange(N)\n\n    for it in range(n_iter):\n        h_style = style[batter]\n        h_bq = quality[batter] + split[batter] * sign_ps\n        h_kind = kind[bowler]\n        h_bwlq = bowl_quality[bowler]\n        h_cond = (\n            venue_level[venue]\n            + era[season]\n            + affinity[batter, venue]\n            + at_home * home_lift\n            + type_table[hand, bowl_style_ball]\n            - pitch_table[bowl_style_ball, pitch]\n            + chasing * (venue_dew[venue] - wear)\n            + day[match_idx]\n        )\n        z = (\n            z_pub\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_style, bs)\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_bq, bq)\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_kind, wt)\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_bwlq, wq)\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_cond, cc)\n        )\n        z = z - z.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n        p = np.exp(z)\n        p = p / p.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n\n        r = -p.copy()\n        r[idxN, outcome] += 1.0\n\n        g_bs = r @ bs\n        g_bq = r @ bq\n        g_wt = r @ wt\n        g_wq = r @ wq\n        g_c = r @ cc\n\n        pd_bs = p @ bs2 - (p @ bs) ** 2\n        pd_bq = p @ bq2 - (p @ bq) ** 2\n        pd_wt = p @ wt2 - (p @ wt) ** 2\n        pd_wq = p @ wq2 - (p @ wq) ** 2\n        pd_c = p @ cc2 - (p @ cc) ** 2\n\n        # Batter parameters\n        num = np.bincount(batter, weights=g_bs, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(batter, weights=pd_bs, minlength=n_players)\n        style = style + (num - style / var_style) / (den + 1.0 / var_style)\n\n        num = np.bincount(batter, weights=g_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(batter, weights=pd_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        quality = quality + (num - quality / var_quality) / (den + 1.0 / var_quality)\n\n        num = np.bincount(batter, weights=sign_ps * g_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(batter, weights=sign2 * pd_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        split = split + (num - split / var_split) / (den + 1.0 / var_split)\n\n        # Bowler parameters\n        num = np.bincount(bowler, weights=g_wt, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(bowler, weights=pd_wt, minlength=n_players)\n        kind = kind + (num - kind / var_kind) / (den + 1.0 / var_kind)\n        kind[~bowled] = 0.0\n\n        num = np.bincount(bowler, weights=g_wq, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(bowler, weights=pd_wq, minlength=n_players)\n        bowl_quality = bowl_quality + (num - bowl_quality / var_bwlq) / (den + 1.0 / var_bwlq)\n        bowl_quality[~bowled] = 0.0\n\n        # Venue level\n        num = np.bincount(venue, weights=g_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        den = np.bincount(venue, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        venue_level = venue_level + (num - venue_level / var_vlevel) / (den + 1.0 / var_vlevel)\n\n        # Venue dew (only when chasing)\n        num = np.bincount(venue, weights=chasing * g_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        den = np.bincount(venue, weights=chasing * pd_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        venue_dew = venue_dew + (num - venue_dew / var_vdew) / (den + 1.0 / var_vdew)\n\n        # Era per season\n        num = np.bincount(season, weights=g_c, minlength=n_seasons)\n        den = np.bincount(season, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_seasons)\n        era = era + (num - era / var_era) / (den + 1.0 / var_era)\n\n        # Home lift (scalar; coefficient = at_home)\n        g_home = float(np.sum(at_home * g_c))\n        h_home = float(np.sum(at_home * pd_c))\n        home_lift = home_lift + (g_home - home_lift / var_home) / (h_home + 1.0 / var_home)\n\n        # Wear (scalar; coefficient = -chasing)\n        g_wear = float(np.sum(-chasing * g_c))\n        h_wear = float(np.sum(chasing * pd_c))\n        wear = wear + (g_wear - wear / var_wear) / (h_wear + 1.0 / var_wear)\n\n        # Type table [hand, bowl_style]\n        num = np.bincount(hand_style_ix, weights=g_c, minlength=4).reshape(2, 2)\n        den = np.bincount(hand_style_ix, weights=pd_c, minlength=4).reshape(2, 2)\n        type_table = type_table + (num - type_table / var_typet) / (den + 1.0 / var_typet)\n\n        # Pitch table [bowl_style, pitch] with negative sign coefficient\n        num = np.bincount(style_pitch_ix, weights=-g_c, minlength=6).reshape(2, 3)\n        den = np.bincount(style_pitch_ix, weights=pd_c, minlength=6).reshape(2, 3)\n        pitch_table = pitch_table + (num - pitch_table / var_pitcht) / (den + 1.0 / var_pitcht)\n\n        # Affinity per (batter, venue)\n        num = np.bincount(bv_idx, weights=g_c, minlength=n_players * n_venues).reshape(n_players, n_venues)\n        den = np.bincount(bv_idx, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_players * n_venues).reshape(n_players, n_venues)\n        affinity = affinity + (num - affinity / var_aff) / (den + 1.0 / var_aff)\n\n        # Day-of-match effect (per match)\n        num = np.bincount(match_idx, weights=g_c, minlength=n_matches)\n        den = np.bincount(match_idx, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_matches)\n        day = day + (num - day / var_day) / (den + 1.0 / var_day)\n\n        if verbose:\n            # log-likelihood on the same P we just computed\n            ll = float(np.log(np.maximum(p[idxN, outcome], 1e-30)).sum())\n            print(f\"iter {it}: ll = {ll:.2f}\")\n\n    # Estimate day_sd from spread of fitted per-match day effects.\n    # Fitted day is shrunk toward 0 by the prior; empirical std is a reasonable\n    # rough estimate (the pitch spread is what the simulator draws from).\n    if n_matches > 1:\n        day_sd = float(np.std(day))\n    else:\n        day_sd = 0.0\n\n    # Extrapolate era to the next season by linear fit on observed seasons.\n    if n_seasons >= 2:\n        s = np.arange(n_seasons)\n        a, b = np.polyfit(s, era, 1)\n        era_future = float(a * n_seasons + b)\n    else:\n        era_future = float(era[-1])\n\n    book = SkillBook(\n        players,\n        venues,\n        style,\n        quality,\n        split,\n        kind,\n        bowl_quality,\n        type_table,\n        pitch_table,\n        venue_level,\n        venue_dew,\n        affinity,\n        home_lift,\n        era_future,\n        day_sd,\n        wear,\n    )\n    return book\n\n\ndef main():\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"--league\", required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--out\", required=True)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--sims\", type=int, default=8000)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--iters\", type=int, default=40)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--seed\", type=int, default=0xC0FFEE)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--verbose\", action=\"store_true\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    np.random.seed(args.seed)\n    history, fixtures = load_league(args.league)\n    model = load_public_model()\n    book = fit_hidden(history, model, n_iter=args.iters, verbose=args.verbose)\n\n    simulator = MatchSimulator(model)\n    gen = np.random.default_rng(args.seed)\n    rows = []\n    for f in fixtures:\n        p = simulator.win_probability(book, f, args.sims, gen)\n        p = float(np.clip(p, 0.002, 0.998))\n home-win probabilities for the fixtures of a simulated T20 league.\n\nWe do MAP inference on the hidden per-player and per-venue values that enter\nthe engine's ball-by-ball logistic model, then Monte-Carlo simulate each\nfixture with the fitted SkillBook.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport argparse\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\n\n_HERE = Path(__file__).resolve()\nsys.path.insert(0, str(_HERE.parent.parent))\n\nfrom engine.league_io import load_league  # noqa: E402\nfrom engine.model import (  # noqa: E402\n    MatchSimulator,\n    PACE,\n    SkillBook,\n    load_public_model,\n)\n\n\ndef _public_logits(model, over, position, wickets_before, chasing, pressure):\n    cal = model.cal\n    z = cal.over_logits[over] + cal.position_vectors[position]\n    z = z + np.multiply.outer(wickets_before - cal.typical_wickets[over], cal.wickets_vector)\n    z = z + np.multiply.outer(chasing, cal.second_innings_vector)\n    z = z + np.multiply.outer(pressure, cal.pressure_vector)\n    return z\n\n\ndef fit_hidden(history, model, n_iter=40, verbose=False):\n    balls = history.balls\n    players = history.players\n    venues = history.venues\n    cal = model.cal\n    N = len(balls)\n\n    outcome = balls.outcome.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    over = balls.over.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    position = balls.position.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    wickets_before = balls.wickets_before.to_numpy().astype(float)\n    runs_before = balls.runs_before.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    target_arr = balls.target.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    chasing = (target_arr > 0).astype(float)\n    ball_in_over = balls.ball.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    ball_total = over * 6 + ball_in_over\n\n    # pressure only in chase\n    overs_remaining = np.maximum((120 - ball_total) / 6.0, 1e-6)\n    need_rate = np.maximum(target_arr - runs_before, 1).astype(float) / overs_remaining\n    par = cal.par_rate[over]\n    press = np.clip(np.log(need_rate / par), -1.0, 1.2)\n    pressure = np.where(chasing > 0, press, 0.0)\n\n    z_pub = _public_logits(model, over, position, wickets_before, chasing, pressure)\n\n    batter = balls.batter.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    bowler = balls.bowler.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    venue = balls.venue.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    batting_team = balls.batting_team.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    match_id = balls.match.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    season = balls.season.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n\n    hand = players.hand[batter]\n    bowl_style_ball = players.style[bowler]\n    pitch = venues.pitch[venue]\n    home_of_venue = venues.home_team[venue]\n    at_home = (batting_team == home_of_venue).astype(float)\n\n    sign_ps = np.where(bowl_style_ball == PACE, 0.5, -0.5)\n\n    n_players = len(players.role)\n    n_venues = len(venues.pitch)\n    n_seasons = int(history.seasons)\n\n    matches_unique = np.unique(match_id)\n    m2i = {int(m): i for i, m in enumerate(matches_unique)}\n    match_idx = np.array([m2i[int(m)] for m in match_id])\n    n_matches = len(matches_unique)\n\n    bowled = np.zeros(n_players, dtype=bool)\n    bowled[np.unique(bowler)] = True\n\n    style = np.zeros(n_players)\n    quality = np.zeros(n_players)\n    split = np.zeros(n_players)\n    kind = np.zeros(n_players)\n    bowl_quality = np.zeros(n_players)\n    venue_level = np.zeros(n_venues)\n    venue_dew = np.zeros(n_venues)\n    affinity = np.zeros((n_players, n_venues))\n    era = np.zeros(n_seasons)\n    home_lift = 0.0\n    wear = 0.0\n    type_table = np.zeros((2, 2))\n    pitch_table = np.zeros((2, 3))\n    day = np.zeros(n_matches)\n\n    bs = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bat_style\"])\n    bq = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bat_quality\"])\n    wt = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bowl_type\"])\n    wq = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bowl_quality\"])\n    cc = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"conditions\"])\n    bs2, bq2, wt2, wq2, cc2 = bs**2, bq**2, wt**2, wq**2, cc**2\n\n    # Prior variances (informed guesses).\n    var_style = 0.6**2\n    var_quality = 0.8**2\n    var_split = 0.3**2\n    var_kind = 1.0**2\n    var_bwlq = 0.8**2\n    var_vlevel = 0.3**2\n    var_vdew = 0.25**2\n    var_aff = 0.15**2\n    var_era = 0.3**2\n    var_home = 0.25**2\n    var_wear = 0.2**2\n    var_typet = 0.15**2\n    var_pitcht = 0.25**2\n    var_day = 0.25**2\n\n    hand_style_ix = hand * 2 + bowl_style_ball\n    style_pitch_ix = bowl_style_ball * 3 + pitch\n    bv_idx = batter * n_venues + venue\n    sign2 = sign_ps * sign_ps  # constantly 0.25\n\n    idxN = np.arange(N)\n\n    def newton(x, num, den, var):\n        return (num - x / var) / (den + 1.0 / var)\n\n    for it in range(n_iter):\n        step = 0.35  # damping to keep the block-coordinate updates stable\n        h_style = style[batter]\n        h_bq = quality[batter] + split[batter] * sign_ps\n        h_kind = kind[bowler]\n        h_bwlq = bowl_quality[bowler]\n        h_cond = (\n            venue_level[venue]\n            + era[season]\n            + affinity[batter, venue]\n            + at_home * home_lift\n            + type_table[hand, bowl_style_ball]\n            - pitch_table[bowl_style_ball, pitch]\n            + chasing * (venue_dew[venue] - wear)\n            + day[match_idx]\n        )\n        z = (\n            z_pub\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_style, bs)\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_bq, bq)\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_kind, wt)\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_bwlq, wq)\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_cond, cc)\n        )\n        z = z - z.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n        p = np.exp(z)\n        p = p / p.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n\n        r = -p.copy()\n        r[idxN, outcome] += 1.0\n\n        g_bs = r @ bs\n        g_bq = r @ bq\n        g_wt = r @ wt\n        g_wq = r @ wq\n        g_c = r @ cc\n\n        pd_bs = p @ bs2 - (p @ bs) ** 2\n        pd_bq = p @ bq2 - (p @ bq) ** 2\n        pd_wt = p @ wt2 - (p @ wt) ** 2\n        pd_wq = p @ wq2 - (p @ wq) ** 2\n        pd_c = p @ cc2 - (p @ cc) ** 2\n\n        # Batter parameters\n        num = np.bincount(batter, weights=g_bs, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(batter, weights=pd_bs, minlength=n_players)\n        style = style + (num - style / var_style) / (den + 1.0 / var_style)\n\n        num = np.bincount(batter, weights=g_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(batter, weights=pd_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        quality = quality + (num - quality / var_quality) / (den + 1.0 / var_quality)\n\n        num = np.bincount(batter, weights=sign_ps * g_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(batter, weights=sign2 * pd_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        split = split + (num - split / var_split) / (den + 1.0 / var_split)\n\n        # Bowler parameters\n        num = np.bincount(bowler, weights=g_wt, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(bowler, weights=pd_wt, minlength=n_players)\n        kind = kind + (num - kind / var_kind) / (den + 1.0 / var_kind)\n        kind[~bowled] = 0.0\n\n        num = np.bincount(bowler, weights=g_wq, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(bowler, weights=pd_wq, minlength=n_players)\n        bowl_quality = bowl_quality + (num - bowl_quality / var_bwlq) / (den + 1.0 / var_bwlq)\n        bowl_quality[~bowled] = 0.0\n\n        # Venue level\n        num = np.bincount(venue, weights=g_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        den = np.bincount(venue, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        venue_level = venue_level + (num - venue_level / var_vlevel) / (den + 1.0 / var_vlevel)\n\n        # Venue dew (only when chasing)\n        num = np.bincount(venue, weights=chasing * g_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        den = np.bincount(venue, weights=chasing * pd_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        venue_dew = venue_dew + (num - venue_dew / var_vdew) / (den + 1.0 / var_vdew)\n\n        # Era per season\n        num = np.bincount(season, weights=g_c, minlength=n_seasons)\n        den = np.bincount(season, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_seasons)\n        era = era + (num - era / var_era) / (den + 1.0 / var_era)\n\n        # Home lift (scalar; coefficient = at_home)\n        g_home = float(np.sum(at_home * g_c))\n        h_home = float(np.sum(at_home * pd_c))\n        home_lift = home_lift + (g_home - home_lift / var_home) / (h_home + 1.0 / var_home)\n\n        # Wear (scalar; coefficient = -chasing)\n        g_wear = float(np.sum(-chasing * g_c))\n        h_wear = float(np.sum(chasing * pd_c))\n        wear = wear + (g_wear - wear / var_wear) / (h_wear + 1.0 / var_wear)\n\n        # Type table [hand, bowl_style]\n        num = np.bincount(hand_style_ix, weights=g_c, minlength=4).reshape(2, 2)\n        den = np.bincount(hand_style_ix, weights=pd_c, minlength=4).reshape(2, 2)\n        type_table = type_table + (num - type_table / var_typet) / (den + 1.0 / var_typet)\n\n        # Pitch table [bowl_style, pitch] with negative sign coefficient\n        num = np.bincount(style_pitch_ix, weights=-g_c, minlength=6).reshape(2, 3)\n        den = np.bincount(style_pitch_ix, weights=pd_c, minlength=6).reshape(2, 3)\n        pitch_table = pitch_table + (num - pitch_table / var_pitcht) / (den + 1.0 / var_pitcht)\n\n        # Affinity per (batter, venue)\n        num = np.bincount(bv_idx, weights=g_c, minlength=n_players * n_venues).reshape(n_players, n_venues)\n        den = np.bincount(bv_idx, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_players * n_venues).reshape(n_players, n_venues)\n        affinity = affinity + (num - affinity / var_aff) / (den + 1.0 / var_aff)\n\n        # Day-of-match effect (per match)\n        num = np.bincount(match_idx, weights=g_c, minlength=n_matches)\n        den = np.bincount(match_idx, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_matches)\n        day = day + (num - day / var_day) / (den + 1.0 / var_day)\n\n        if verbose:\n            # log-likelihood on the same P we just computed\n            ll = float(np.log(np.maximum(p[idxN, outcome], 1e-30)).sum())\n            print(f\"iter {it}: ll = {ll:.2f}\")\n\n    # Estimate day_sd from spread of fitted per-match day effects.\n    # Fitted day is shrunk toward 0 by the prior; empirical std is a reasonable\n    # rough estimate (the pitch spread is what the simulator draws from).\n    if n_matches > 1:\n        day_sd = float(np.std(day))\n    else:\n        day_sd = 0.0\n\n    # Extrapolate era to the next season by linear fit on observed seasons.\n    if n_seasons >= 2:\n        s = np.arange(n_seasons)\n        a, b = np.polyfit(s, era, 1)\n        era_future = float(a * n_seasons + b)\n    else:\n        era_future = float(era[-1])\n\n    book = SkillBook(\n        players,\n        venues,\n        style,\n        quality,\n        split,\n        kind,\n        bowl_quality,\n        type_table,\n        pitch_table,\n        venue_level,\n        venue_dew,\n        affinity,\n        home_lift,\n        era_future,\n        day_sd,\n        wear,\n    )\n    return book\n\n\ndef main():\n between blocks","originalFile":"\"\"\"Forecast home-win probabilities for the fixtures of a simulated T20 league.\n\nWe do MAP inference on the hidden per-player and per-venue values that enter\nthe engine's ball-by-ball logistic model, then Monte-Carlo simulate each\nfixture with the fitted SkillBook.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport argparse\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\n\n_HERE = Path(__file__).resolve()\nsys.path.insert(0, str(_HERE.parent.parent))\n\nfrom engine.league_io import load_league  # noqa: E402\nfrom engine.model import (  # noqa: E402\n    MatchSimulator,\n    PACE,\n    SkillBook,\n    load_public_model,\n)\n\n\ndef _public_logits(model, over, position, wickets_before, chasing, pressure):\n    cal = model.cal\n    z = cal.over_logits[over] + cal.position_vectors[position]\n    z = z + np.multiply.outer(wickets_before - cal.typical_wickets[over], cal.wickets_vector)\n    z = z + np.multiply.outer(chasing, cal.second_innings_vector)\n    z = z + np.multiply.outer(pressure, cal.pressure_vector)\n    return z\n\n\ndef fit_hidden(history, model, n_iter=40, verbose=False):\n    balls = history.balls\n    players = history.players\n    venues = history.venues\n    cal = model.cal\n    N = len(balls)\n\n    outcome = balls.outcome.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    over = balls.over.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    position = balls.position.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    wickets_before = balls.wickets_before.to_numpy().astype(float)\n    runs_before = balls.runs_before.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    target_arr = balls.target.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    chasing = (target_arr > 0).astype(float)\n    ball_in_over = balls.ball.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    ball_total = over * 6 + ball_in_over\n\n    # pressure only in chase\n    overs_remaining = np.maximum((120 - ball_total) / 6.0, 1e-6)\n    need_rate = np.maximum(target_arr - runs_before, 1).astype(float) / overs_remaining\n    par = cal.par_rate[over]\n    press = np.clip(np.log(need_rate / par), -1.0, 1.2)\n    pressure = np.where(chasing > 0, press, 0.0)\n\n    z_pub = _public_logits(model, over, position, wickets_before, chasing, pressure)\n\n    batter = balls.batter.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    bowler = balls.bowler.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    venue = balls.venue.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    batting_team = balls.batting_team.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    match_id = balls.match.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n    season = balls.season.to_numpy().astype(np.int64)\n\n    hand = players.hand[batter]\n    bowl_style_ball = players.style[bowler]\n    pitch = venues.pitch[venue]\n    home_of_venue = venues.home_team[venue]\n    at_home = (batting_team == home_of_venue).astype(float)\n\n    sign_ps = np.where(bowl_style_ball == PACE, 0.5, -0.5)\n\n    n_players = len(players.role)\n    n_venues = len(venues.pitch)\n    n_seasons = int(history.seasons)\n\n    matches_unique = np.unique(match_id)\n    m2i = {int(m): i for i, m in enumerate(matches_unique)}\n    match_idx = np.array([m2i[int(m)] for m in match_id])\n    n_matches = len(matches_unique)\n\n    bowled = np.zeros(n_players, dtype=bool)\n    bowled[np.unique(bowler)] = True\n\n    style = np.zeros(n_players)\n    quality = np.zeros(n_players)\n    split = np.zeros(n_players)\n    kind = np.zeros(n_players)\n    bowl_quality = np.zeros(n_players)\n    venue_level = np.zeros(n_venues)\n    venue_dew = np.zeros(n_venues)\n    affinity = np.zeros((n_players, n_venues))\n    era = np.zeros(n_seasons)\n    home_lift = 0.0\n    wear = 0.0\n    type_table = np.zeros((2, 2))\n    pitch_table = np.zeros((2, 3))\n    day = np.zeros(n_matches)\n\n    bs = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bat_style\"])\n    bq = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bat_quality\"])\n    wt = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bowl_type\"])\n    wq = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"bowl_quality\"])\n    cc = np.asarray(cal.directions[\"conditions\"])\n    bs2, bq2, wt2, wq2, cc2 = bs**2, bq**2, wt**2, wq**2, cc**2\n\n    # Prior variances (informed guesses).\n    var_style = 0.6**2\n    var_quality = 0.8**2\n    var_split = 0.3**2\n    var_kind = 1.0**2\n    var_bwlq = 0.8**2\n    var_vlevel = 0.3**2\n    var_vdew = 0.25**2\n    var_aff = 0.15**2\n    var_era = 0.3**2\n    var_home = 0.25**2\n    var_wear = 0.2**2\n    var_typet = 0.15**2\n    var_pitcht = 0.25**2\n    var_day = 0.25**2\n\n    hand_style_ix = hand * 2 + bowl_style_ball\n    style_pitch_ix = bowl_style_ball * 3 + pitch\n    bv_idx = batter * n_venues + venue\n    sign2 = sign_ps * sign_ps  # constantly 0.25\n\n    idxN = np.arange(N)\n\n    def newton(x, num, den, var):\n        return (num - x / var) / (den + 1.0 / var)\n\n    for it in range(n_iter):\n        step = 0.35  # damping to keep the block-coordinate updates stable\n        h_style = style[batter]\n        h_bq = quality[batter] + split[batter] * sign_ps\n        h_kind = kind[bowler]\n        h_bwlq = bowl_quality[bowler]\n        h_cond = (\n            venue_level[venue]\n            + era[season]\n            + affinity[batter, venue]\n            + at_home * home_lift\n            + type_table[hand, bowl_style_ball]\n            - pitch_table[bowl_style_ball, pitch]\n            + chasing * (venue_dew[venue] - wear)\n            + day[match_idx]\n        )\n        z = (\n            z_pub\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_style, bs)\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_bq, bq)\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_kind, wt)\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_bwlq, wq)\n            + np.multiply.outer(h_cond, cc)\n        )\n        z = z - z.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n        p = np.exp(z)\n        p = p / p.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n\n        r = -p.copy()\n        r[idxN, outcome] += 1.0\n\n        g_bs = r @ bs\n        g_bq = r @ bq\n        g_wt = r @ wt\n        g_wq = r @ wq\n        g_c = r @ cc\n\n        pd_bs = p @ bs2 - (p @ bs) ** 2\n        pd_bq = p @ bq2 - (p @ bq) ** 2\n        pd_wt = p @ wt2 - (p @ wt) ** 2\n        pd_wq = p @ wq2 - (p @ wq) ** 2\n        pd_c = p @ cc2 - (p @ cc) ** 2\n\n        # Batter parameters\n        num = np.bincount(batter, weights=g_bs, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(batter, weights=pd_bs, minlength=n_players)\n        style = style + step * newton(style, num, den, var_style)\n\n        num = np.bincount(batter, weights=g_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(batter, weights=pd_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        quality = quality + step * newton(quality, num, den, var_quality)\n\n        num = np.bincount(batter, weights=sign_ps * g_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(batter, weights=sign2 * pd_bq, minlength=n_players)\n        split = split + step * newton(split, num, den, var_split)\n\n        # Bowler parameters\n        num = np.bincount(bowler, weights=g_wt, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(bowler, weights=pd_wt, minlength=n_players)\n        kind = kind + step * newton(kind, num, den, var_kind)\n        kind[~bowled] = 0.0\n\n        num = np.bincount(bowler, weights=g_wq, minlength=n_players)\n        den = np.bincount(bowler, weights=pd_wq, minlength=n_players)\n        bowl_quality = bowl_quality + step * newton(bowl_quality, num, den, var_bwlq)\n        bowl_quality[~bowled] = 0.0\n\n        # Venue level\n        num = np.bincount(venue, weights=g_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        den = np.bincount(venue, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        venue_level = venue_level + step * newton(venue_level, num, den, var_vlevel)\n\n        # Venue dew (only when chasing)\n        num = np.bincount(venue, weights=chasing * g_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        den = np.bincount(venue, weights=chasing * pd_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        venue_dew = venue_dew + step * newton(venue_dew, num, den, var_vdew)\n\n        # Era per season\n        num = np.bincount(season, weights=g_c, minlength=n_seasons)\n        den = np.bincount(season, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_seasons)\n        era = era + step * newton(era, num, den, var_era)\n\n        # Home lift (scalar; coefficient = at_home)\n        g_home = float(np.sum(at_home * g_c))\n        h_home = float(np.sum(at_home * pd_c))\n        home_lift = home_lift + step * (g_home - home_lift / var_home) / (h_home + 1.0 / var_home)\n\n        # Wear (scalar; coefficient = -chasing)\n        g_wear = float(np.sum(-chasing * g_c))\n        h_wear = float(np.sum(chasing * pd_c))\n        wear = wear + step * (g_wear - wear / var_wear) / (h_wear + 1.0 / var_wear)\n\n        # Type table [hand, bowl_style]\n        num = np.bincount(hand_style_ix, weights=g_c, minlength=4).reshape(2, 2)\n        den = np.bincount(hand_style_ix, weights=pd_c, minlength=4).reshape(2, 2)\n        type_table = type_table + step * newton(type_table, num, den, var_typet)\n\n        # Pitch table [bowl_style, pitch] with negative sign coefficient\n        num = np.bincount(style_pitch_ix, weights=-g_c, minlength=6).reshape(2, 3)\n        den = np.bincount(style_pitch_ix, weights=pd_c, minlength=6).reshape(2, 3)\n        pitch_table = pitch_table + step * newton(pitch_table, num, den, var_pitcht)\n\n        # Affinity per (batter, venue)\n        num = np.bincount(bv_idx, weights=g_c, minlength=n_players * n_venues).reshape(n_players, n_venues)\n        den = np.bincount(bv_idx, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_players * n_venues).reshape(n_players, n_venues)\n        affinity = affinity + step * newton(affinity, num, den, var_aff)\n\n        # Day-of-match effect (per match)\n        num = np.bincount(match_idx, weights=g_c, minlength=n_matches)\n        den = np.bincount(match_idx, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_matches)\n        day = day + step * newton(day, num, den, var_day)\n\n        if verbose:\n            # log-likelihood on the same P we just computed\n            ll = float(np.log(np.maximum(p[idxN, outcome], 1e-30)).sum())\n            print(f\"iter {it}: ll = {ll:.2f}\")\n\n    # Estimate day_sd from spread of fitted per-match day effects.\n    # Fitted day is shrunk toward 0 by the prior; empirical std is a reasonable\n    # rough estimate (the pitch spread is what the simulator draws from).\n    if n_matches > 1:\n        day_sd = float(np.std(day))\n    else:\n        day_sd = 0.0\n\n    # Extrapolate era to the next season by linear fit on observed seasons.\n    if n_seasons >= 2:\n        s = np.arange(n_seasons)\n        a, b = np.polyfit(s, era, 1)\n        era_future = float(a * n_seasons + b)\n    else:\n        era_future = float(era[-1])\n\n    book = SkillBook(\n        players,\n        venues,\n        style,\n        quality,\n        split,\n        kind,\n        bowl_quality,\n        type_table,\n        pitch_table,\n        venue_level,\n        venue_dew,\n        affinity,\n * pd_c))\n        home_lift = home_lift + (g_home - home_lift / var_home) / (h_home + 1.0 / var_home)\n        g_wear = float(np.sum(-chasing * g_c))\n        h_wear = float(np.sum(chasing * pd_c))\n        wear = wear + (g_wear - wear / var_wear) / (h_wear + 1.0 / var_wear)\n\n        p = compute_p()\n        g_c, pd_c = residual_and_info(p, cc, cc2)\n        num = np.bincount(hand_style_ix, weights=g_c, minlength=4).reshape(2, 2)\n        den = np.bincount(hand_style_ix, weights=pd_c, minlength=4).reshape(2, 2)\n        type_table = type_table + newton(type_table, num, den, var_typet)\n\n        p = compute_p()\n        g_c, pd_c = residual_and_info(p, cc, cc2)\n        num = np.bincount(style_pitch_ix, weights=-g_c, minlength=6).reshape(2, 3)\n        den = residual_and_info(p, cc, cc2)\n        num = np.bincount(venue, weights=chasing * g_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        den = np.bincount(venue, weights=chasing * pd_c, minlength=n_venues)\n        venue_dew = venue_dew + newton(venue_dew, num, den, var_vdew)\n\n        p = compute_p()\n        g_c, pd_c = residual_and_info(p, cc, cc2)\n        num = np.bincount(bv_idx, weights=g_c, minlength=n_players * n_venues).reshape(n_players, n_venues)\n        den = np.bincount(bv_idx, weights=pd_c, minlength=n_players * n_venues).reshape(n_players, n_venues)\n        affinity = affinity + newton(affinity, num, den, var_aff)\n\n        p = compute_p()\n        g_c, pd_c = residual_and_info(p, cc, cc2)\n        num = np.bincount(match_idx, weights=g_c, minlength=n_matches)\n        den
